name: Premier League
note: The reference. Every other weight is read relative to this one.

name: UEFA Champions League
note: Strongest regular opposition in club football; minutes are if anything understated in a form index.

name: UEFA Champions League Qualification
note: Real European opposition, but uneven quality across rounds.

name: UEFA Europa League
note: Comparable to mid-table Premier League opposition on average.

name: UEFA Conference League
note: Weaker on average, with a long tail of very weak sides.

name: FA Cup
note: The tournament average; weighted by round where the source gives round detail.

name: EFL Cup
note: Rotation-heavy: minutes here say more about squad depth than about form.

name: EFL Trophy
note: Under-21 sides and lower divisions; excludes itself from the index.

name: Community Shield
note: One match, and rarely a competitive selection.

name: FIFA Club World Cup
note: Strong field, small sample; capped by the minutes cap rather than the weight.

name: World Cup
note: The highest standard of opposition in the sport.

name: European Championship
note: Second only to the World Cup in depth.

name: Copa America
note: Comparable strength to the Euros.

name: Africa Cup of Nations
note: Strong tournament; mid-season scheduling makes its minutes unusually costly.

name: AFC Asian Cup
note: Uneven strength across the field, competitive at the top.

name: WC Qualification
note: Averaged across confederations; the spread inside this row is the widest in the table.

name: EC Qualification
note: European qualifiers are a reasonable standard throughout.

name: UEFA Nations League
note: Competitive by design, unlike a friendly.

name: Friendlies
note: Where minutes mean least: substitutions are near-arbitrary and the opposition is chosen for convenience.

name: Club Friendlies
note: Pre-season minutes are fitness, not form.

name: Youth or age-group
note: Age-group football is a different task; it belongs in a development view, not a form index.

name: Other recorded competition
note: Used when a competition is named but absent from this table. Flagged so nobody mistakes it for a decision.
